edges.reason: Owned constructor writes the owner storage slot during deployment.
msg.sender is directly stored as the initial owner, granting privileged control to the deployer.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender == owner before allowing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership authorizes msg.sender against the staged newOwner address.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, changing privileged control.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0), completing the two-step handover.
TokenNetwork constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
TokenNetwork constructor initializes the name state variable.
TokenNetwork constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
TokenNetwork constructor sets _totalSupply to the full supply value.
TokenNetwork constructor mints the whole supply into balances of a fixed address.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply to compute the reported supply.
totalSupply() subtracts balances[address(0)] from the cached supply.
balanceOf() returns the balances mapping entry for the queried account.
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls the source account.
transfer() reads and writes the balances mapping for both parties.
transfer() stores updated balances back into the balances mapping.
transfer() delegates the balance subtraction to safeSub.
transfer() delegates the recipient balance addition to safeAdd.
safeSub result flows into the balances slot written by transfer/transferFrom.
safeAdd result flows into the balances slot written by transfer/transferFrom.
approve() unconditionally overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with tokens.
approve() keys the allowance on msg.sender, making the caller the allowance owner.
transferFrom() consumes allowed[from][msg.sender], tying spending rights to the caller.
transferFrom() mutates the balances mapping for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom() decrements the allowed mapping entry of the caller.
transferFrom() calls safeSub for both the balance and allowance subtraction.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall() keys the allowance write on msg.sender.
approveAndCall() sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] before performing the external call.
The caller-supplied spender parameter is the target contract of the receiveApproval external call.
approveAndCall() hands control to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, enabling reentrant state reads/writes.
transferAnyERC20Token() performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract, transferring control out of the contract.
transferAnyERC20Token() is guarded by onlyOwner and forwards funds to the owner address.
The 'to' parameter determines the credit target inside transfer().
The 'tokens' parameter determines the amount moved inside transfer().
The 'from' parameter is the account debited inside transferFrom().
The 'to' parameter is the account credited inside transferFrom().
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount moved and subtracted from allowance inside transferFrom().
The 'spender' parameter is used both as allowance key and external callee in approveAndCall().
The 'tokens' parameter sets the allowance in approveAndCall().
The 'data' parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
The 'tokenAddress' parameter selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token().
The 'tokens' parameter sets the amount forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token().
safeAdd computes a + b into the local result c before the overflow require.
safeSub computes a - b into the local result c before the underflow require.
safeMul computes a * b into the local result c before the overflow require.
safeDiv computes a / b into the local result c before returning.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only has meaning as an argument of transfer().
The amount parameter only has meaning as an argument of transfer().
The debit source parameter belongs to the transferFrom() signature.
The credit destination parameter belongs to the transferFrom() signature.
The amount parameter belongs to the transferFrom() signature.
The spender parameter is consumed directly by approveAndCall() and by its external call.
The tokens parameter is consumed directly by approveAndCall().
The data blob is consumed directly by approveAndCall() and forwarded to the callee.
The token address parameter is only used inside transferAnyERC20Token().
Local result c exists solely inside safeAdd().
Local result c exists solely inside safeSub().
Local result c exists solely inside safeMul().
Local result c exists solely inside safeDiv().
